tools.name: solve
tools.description: Solve an optimization model written as typed math or LaTeX (maximize/minimize ..., subject to ...). tier: Low, Medium or High. Returns status, objective, solution, proof_label and the verification (feasibility of every constraint, dual or KKT check), and for each constraint its value, slack, whether

tools.name: dual
tools.description: Formulate and solve the dual of a linear program or convex QP (typed math); reports strong or weak duality.

tools.name: kkt
tools.description: KKT (Lagrange multiplier) certificate at the solution of a smooth nonlinear model (typed math): multipliers, residual and whether the conditions hold.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Solve a model (typed math or LaTeX) and return the answer (status, objective, solution, proof_label, verification) with the step-by-step walkthrough as Markdown, at a depth from 1 (mostly plain words) to 10 (every detail: indices, duals, code), default 3. tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search ProvenDecisions' content: tutorials, refreshers (calculus), solved examples, help, daily (Daily Update on optimization news), posts (New in AI), reports and glossary (definitions of terms). kinds: optional list of those names. Returns up to 5 hits per kind with kind, slug, title and a snippet

tools.name: get_content
tools.description: Read one item: kind is tutorials, refreshers, examples, daily, posts, help, reports or glossary; slug from search_content or list_content. Tutorials come as Markdown with LaTeX math; examples with the solver's stored result and walkthrough; tutorials above the user's plan are refused.

tools.name: list_content
tools.description: List the items of one kind (tutorials, refreshers, examples, daily, posts, help, reports, glossary), paged with limit (1-100, default 20) and offset. section: learn or refreshers for tutorials.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "solve" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Solve an optimization model written as typed math or LaTeX (maximize/minimize ..., subject to ...). tier: Low, Medium or High. Returns status, objective, solution, proof_label and the verification (feasibility of every constraint, dual or KKT check). explain returns the same answer together with a s" → after: "Solve an optimization model written as typed math or LaTeX (maximize/minimize ..., subject to ...). tier: Low, Medium or High. Returns status, objective, solution, proof_label and the verification (feasibility of every constraint, dual or KKT check), and for each constraint its value, slack, whether"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
